label: PROBABILITY_ASSIGNMENT_2: normalized finite additivity on the power set
term: Normalized finite additivity on the power set
definition: A real-valued function on every subset assigns one to the carrier and adds on disjoint pairs. Nonnegativity is deliberately not required in the impossibility theorem.
note: Analyst mathematical vocabulary in the shared carrier-probability module, reused by the plenitude controls (#2143) and the modal-carrier controls (#2142); no source attribution or metaphysical application is assumed.
